# Project Analysis Report

## Overview

This is a Go project containing basic HTTP request handling logic.

## Directory Structure

```
src/
├── main.go
└── handler.go
```

## Key Files

- `src/main.go`: Entry point, starts the HTTP server
- `src/handler.go`: Request handler functions

## Findings and Suggestions

3. Recommend adding a CI/CD configuration
